summary: Completed end-to-end backend + frontend testing for AURA Forest Lake Resort 3D booking app. All 12 backend pytest cases pass (villas, availability, reservations CRUD, overlap/conflict, guest limits, stats). All frontend flows verified via Playwright: 3D canvas + 5 villa pins render, hover shows glassmorphism mini-card, click flies camera in and opens reservation panel drawer with image slider, reservation submission updates panel status pill to 'Reserved for these dates' and villa turns matte grey with amber pulse ring in 3D, close/reset buttons work, nav date change refreshes availability, admin view lists the booking with correct totals, search filter narrows rows, delete removes reservation with toast, and map view toggle returns to 3D.

issues: Metric cards (total bookings/revenue/unique guests) do NOT reflect the search filter — they always show global totals while the table filters. Consider clarifying label or filtering metrics too.

Selecting a villa requires precise mouse position on the mesh; when orbit is active the target moves rapidly making automation and, potentially, casual users on trackpads slightly finicky. Consider expanding pointer target (e.g., invisible pointer-events proxy plane) around villa base.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_availability iterates 5 villas doing find_one each — acceptable at N=5 but for growth prefer a single aggregated query grouping distinct villa_ids with the overlap predicate.

server.py availability endpoint compares check_in/check_out as string ISO — correct because ISO dates sort lexicographically; date format is not validated, so a bad format silently returns empty. Consider Pydantic query model or parse via `date.fromisoformat` and raise 400.
Reservation model stores dates as strings; using a `date` type + JSON-encoder would be cleaner but functionally OK.
ReservationPanel.jsx uses `Number(form.guests)` after storing string from select — fine but consistent typing would be preferable.
Villa.jsx onClick: `if (!booked) onSelect(villa.id)` — silently ignores clicks on booked villas; consider a subtle toast so user knows why nothing happened.

Scene.jsx: onPointerMissed closes the current selection (`onSelect(null)`) — that also fires when clicking the reservation panel edge over the canvas? Panel is a separate DOM sibling so it should be safe, verified.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Created ephemeral TEST_UI_User reservations and cleaned them up. Preserved the pre-existing manual reservation (Ava Lindqvist, villa-01 2026-08-25→28).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py runs 12 cases in ~3s. For frontend, WebGL scene renders reliably but villa selection via mouse requires re-measuring pin bounding box because CameraRig orbits (~0.055 rad/s) until hover. Use offset ~50-90px below the pin bounding box and loop attempts until villa-hover-card-<id> appears (hover pauses orbit), then re-measure and click. Full working helper in prior test scripts. Public URL from frontend/.env: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
